Function Probe() As String
Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, c As Range, s As String, formats(32) As String
Dim i As Long, j As Long
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
formats(0) = "@"
formats(1) = "@*-"
formats(2) = "@"" kg"""
formats(3) = """x""@"
formats(4) = "0;@"
formats(5) = ";;;@"
formats(6) = "General;General;General;@"
formats(7) = "@;@"
formats(8) = "@@"
formats(9) = "[Red]@"
formats(10) = "_(@_)"
formats(11) = "_(* #,##0.00_);_(* \(#,##0.00\);_(* ""-""??_);_(@_)"
formats(12) = "0.00"
formats(13) = "General"
formats(14) = """@"""
formats(15) = "\@"
formats(16) = "@_)"
formats(17) = ";@"
formats(18) = "0;0;0;@"
formats(19) = "[>5]@"
formats(20) = "mm/dd @"
formats(21) = "0;0;0;""x""@"
formats(22) = "General;General;General;@*-"
formats(23) = ";;;""x""@"
formats(24) = ";;;@"" kg"""
formats(25) = "0;0;0;_(@_)"
formats(26) = "0;0;@"
formats(27) = "0;0;0;@_)"
formats(28) = ";;;_(@"
formats(29) = "General;General;General;_(@_)"
formats(30) = "@*-;@"
formats(31) = "0;0;0;[Red]@"
formats(32) = "General;;;@"
On Error Resume Next
For i = 0 To 32
    For j = 1 To 11
        Set c = ws.Cells(i + 1, j)
        Err.Clear
        c.NumberFormat = formats(i)
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            s = s & "|F" & Err.Number
        Else
            Err.Clear
            Select Case j
                Case 1: c.Formula = "=1+1"
                Case 2: c.Value = "=1+1"
                Case 3: c.Value = "123"
                Case 4: c.Value = 123
                Case 5: c.Value2 = 45000
                Case 6: c.Value = "1/2/2026"
                Case 7: c.Formula = "abc"
                Case 8: c.FormulaR1C1 = "=1+1"
                Case 9: c.Value = DateSerial(2026, 1, 2)
                Case 10: c.Value = CCur(12.5)
                Case 11: c.Value = True
            End Select
            If Err.Number <> 0 Then
                s = s & "|E" & Err.Number
            Else
                s = s & "|" & TypeName(c.Value) & "~" & c.HasFormula & "~" & c.Formula & "~" & c.NumberFormat
            End If
        End If
    Next
Next
On Error GoTo 0
wb.Close False
Application.DisplayAlerts = True
Probe = Mid$(s, 2)
End Function
